Receipts.intro: One receipt, several photos if needed. Recognition stays on your device. Review every amount before confirming.
Receipts.overlap: Keep photos in order with 20–30% overlap. Include the header and final total.
Receipts.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP; up to {count} photos, {size} MB each before compression. Photos are private and deleted after confirmation.
Receipts.imageLimit: Use at most {count} photos for one receipt.
Receipts.imageInvalid: Could not prepare this image. Use a smaller JPEG, PNG or WebP image. Manual entry is also available.
Receipts.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Saved photos are safe; retry the missing photo.
Receipts.replaceWarning: This replaces the current editor items with OCR results. Saved photos and successful recognition segments are kept.
Receipts.ocrFailed: Some photos could not be recognized. Successful results were saved. Retry failed photos or enter missing items manually.
Receipts.ocrUnavailable: Recognition is unavailable on this device. Photos remain saved. Enter the receipt manually or try another device.
Receipts.reviewHelp: Recognition may be wrong. Check names, quantities, discounts and totals. Unknown values stay empty.
Receipts.name: Name
Receipts.netTotal: Line totals already include their discounts. Whole-receipt discounts or refunds belong in adjustments. Taxes included in prices must not be added again.
Receipts.acceptMismatch: I checked and accept this difference
Receipts.autosave: Draft changes save after 15 seconds of inactivity. Unconfirmed drafts and their photos expire after 24 hours without activity.
Receipts.cleanup: Receipt photos are removed after confirmation. Temporary cleanup failures are retried automatically.
Receipts.author: By {name}
Receipts.noPurchasesHelp: Confirm a receipt or change the filters. Planned lists do not create expenses.

warnings.lowQuality: Low recognition confidence: check every line.
warnings.ambiguous: Ambiguous overlap. All uncertain lines were kept; check for duplicates.
warnings.order: Photo order may be wrong. Check the sequence and recognize again.
warnings.gap: No reliable overlap was found. Check for missing or repeated items.
warnings.limit: The item limit was reached. Review the receipt manually.
warnings.incomplete: Complete the store, date, total and items before confirming. Recognition may have missed part of the receipt.

Receipts.correctionHelp: Corrections save only when confirmed. The original purchase stays unchanged until then.
Receipts.confirmDeleteDraft: Delete this unfinished receipt and its temporary photos? This cannot be undone.
Receipts.cancelDraftHelp: Leave the editor? Unsaved changes will be discarded. Your saved draft will remain available.
Receipts.ocrQualityHelp: Low confidence: check the photo, every item and the total. Rephotograph flat, with even light and less background if needed.
